verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a REST API for deployed crews, with POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id} and POST /resume endpoints listed in its API reference, and its core Python API (Crew, Agent, Task, Process) is also documented with code examples. Together these let a user or agent drive crews programmatically. However, the REST API covers only crews deployed on the AMP managed platform, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, detailed endpoint coverage beyond kickoff/status/resume, REST access outside the AMP enterprise deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
